# MUS-W-0013

<!-- Generated by `mustur export`. Do not hand-edit: `mustur verify` fails on drift, and the store is the record. -->

**The question lifecycle, and the gate that cannot be reported around**

work-unit · 2026-08-21

Discharges: [MUS-M-0005](../milestones.md#mus-m-0005)

## Context

A question is raised, surfaced, and answered or withdrawn. The gate reads the surfaced field and nothing else.

## Discharges

Part of MUS-M-0005: an agent working Mustur cannot report work complete while an open decision has never been surfaced as a prompt.

## Done means

mustur ask raises a question as an open record.
mustur surfaced records that it reached a prompt; mustur answer closes it, and --withdraw closes it without one.
mustur questions --gate exits non-zero while any open question has never been surfaced, naming each one and what it blocks.
make check runs that gate, and skips out loud when there is no store rather than passing.
A question with no status field counts as open, so a malformed record cannot read as closed.

## Risks

The gate is only as good as the agent running make check, which is the same shape as the mandate clause milestone 1 measured rather than a weaker one. Nothing yet stops an agent raising a question, surfacing it to nobody, and marking it surfaced; the record says who and when, and that is the whole of the deterrent.
